pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal patches characterized by sharp edge gradients. The geometry consists of irregular quadrilaterals and pentagons on the flank, which decrease in size and increase in spatial frequency toward the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored, narrow corridors forming a tessellated negative space. Junctions are predominantly trivalent (Y-shaped) nodes with consistent pixel thickness across the primary flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, dark dorsal mane displaying a fine, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck and transition to the shoulder.
